reasons: Every instruction in SKILL.md that is stated as a fact is shown identically in all three runs, and the unshown parts (clear-before-craft, craft-only-when-craftable) are advice, hedged, and low-risk. Scope is honest (one goal, one arrangement, untested variants flagged) and the description matches the body. Remaining weaknesses are minor: the student is not told its starting stock (the recordings show cobblestone 6, oak_log 3; the chain uses 1 log, 3 cobblestone), so it cannot tell it has enough materials before starting or that one log is enough; it is not told that 4 sticks result but only 2 are used (leftover planks/sticks remain in inventory, inferred), which could lead a weaker model to waste effort or worry; the 'When to use' and 'Capability' lines are thin and 'Only call craft when craftable names the item' is stated twice.
proposedRevisions: Optional: add one line 'You start with cobblestone 6, iron_ingot 6, oak_log 3 (seen in all three runs); the chain needs 1 oak_log and 3 cobblestone, and iron_ingot is not used.' This is SHOWN (call 2) and helps a student confirm it has the materials via inventory.

Optional: add 'Crafts 1 and 2 each make 4 items; you only need 2 oak_planks and 2 sticks, so extras are expected' (yields SHOWN; that extras remain available is INFERRED, so say 'extras are expected' rather than where they go).
Optional: merge the two 'only craft when craftable names the item' sentences into one.
Optional: label the clear advice as 'safe habit' rather than a requirement, since clear was never exercised in the recordings.
Otherwise nothing is worth changing; do not add speculation about other goals.
